title: Existing incoming skill gate blocked company pull request for unrelated inventory finding

statement.observation: GitHub Actions run 41707451395 failed in the existing Incoming skill gate. Its output reported MEDIUM finding large number of URLs (35) in RESOURCE-INVENTORY-SUPPLEMENT-2026-10-21.md. The newly added Validate Company Memory workflow completed successfully in run 41707451188.
statement.inference: The failing gate finding points to an existing repository inventory file and is not reported against the newly added memory files; it remains a PR-level blocker and should not be hidden or bypassed.
statement.recommendation: Keep the gate intact, inspect the cited inventory file and its policy, then make a scoped evidence-backed correction if the finding is valid. Do not suppress the scanner or claim all checks passed.
statement.expected: All applicable pull-request checks complete successfully.
statement.actual: Memory ledger validator passed; Incoming skill gate failed on the cited existing inventory file; other checks were still running at last observation.
statement.impact: PR #12 cannot be considered fully green until the existing gate finding and remaining checks are resolved.

evidence.supports: Workflow run log shows BLOCK and the MEDIUM URL-count finding in RESOURCE-INVENTORY-SUPPLEMENT-2026-10-21.md.
New company memory validation workflow completed successfully.
